definitions.explanation: Writing done quickly and carelessly, often illegible or abbreviated. Used for quick notes jotted down in a hurry.

examples.japanese: ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{走|はし}り{書|が}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I scribbled it on a memo.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}り{書|が}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくい⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧だった。
examples.english: The writing was hard to read because it was scrawled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{書|が}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}き{留|と}めた→書き留める：06730_kakitomeru⟧。
examples.english: I jotted down the contents of the phone call in a hasty scrawl.
There was a hastily scribbled sticky note on the desk.

notes:
Composed of {走|はし}り (running) + {書|が}き (writing) — literally "running writing," conveying the idea of writing done at speed without care for neatness. Can function as a noun or as a suru verb ({走|はし}り{書|が}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走|はし}り{書|が}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: scribble quickly
- {走|はし}り{書|が}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧: a hastily scribbled note
- {走|はし}り{書|が}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: write in a scrawl
- {走|はし}り{書|が}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧: can't read because it's scribbled

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殴|なぐ}り{書|が}き→殴り書き：18047_nagurigaki⟧: scrawl (rougher/messier connotation)
- ⟦{書|か}き{殴|なぐ}る→書き殴る：08253_kakinaguru⟧: dash off writing angrily or carelessly
- ⟦{落書|らくが}き→落書き：14043_rakugaki⟧: doodling, graffiti (different nuance — not about speed)
